title: Hollow Knight
subtitle: A world you gave to bug and beast as they had never dreamed of.
description: Didn't like how the save points were so far away from most bosses. Made the game less fun because you had to go through a boring walk of humiliation to defeat the boss again. As far as I have played, the lore was rather sparse, contrary to what I believed about the game.
